tools.name: split_beams_by_columns
tools.description: Split structural beams at columns (pyRevit: Cutbeambycolumn). Splits the element in place with Revit's own split where it can, so the member, its host and its parameters stay; a member Revit will not split is re-created as location-curve segments instead. Not a solid cut. Straight and curved beams, cut at the real column footprint, not a bounding box. Copies instance parameters (Mark, Comments, offsets) onto pieces it has to re-create. Params: beamIds[], columnIds[] optional (else selection; columns fall back to all in model), dryRun boolean (count only, no model changes), uniqueMark boolean (suffix new Marks -1, -2, ...), copyParams boolean (default true), limit (default 50, max 200). Lengths in mm.

tools.name: split_floors_by_beams
tools.description: Split floors along beam edges and add column openings (pyRevit: Cutslabbybeam). Rebuilds planar floor regions through the flooring API and carries a single-plane slope with a slope arrow; not a solid cut. Handles floors with openings, curved beams and real column footprints; a slab it cannot rebuild exactly is left alone and counted by reason. Copies instance parameters (Mark, Comments, offsets) onto new pieces. Params: floorIds[], beamIds[], columnIds[] optional (else selection; beams/columns fall back to bbox hits), dryRun boolean (count only, no model changes), uniqueMark boolean (suffix new Marks -1, -2, ...), copyParams boolean (default true), limit (default 50, max 200). Lengths in mm.
